print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Not sure how "played so far" should map to queue positions; assuming positions <= current position including current.</uncertainty>')

# Login
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login = apis.spotify.login(username='carbrown@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login['access_token']

# Fetch current queue
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)

# Determine current position and songs played so far (positions <= current)
current_entries = [s for s in queue if s.get('is_current')]
current_position = current_entries[0]['position'] if current_entries else None
songs_played_so_far = [s for s in queue if current_position is not None and s.get('position', 1e9) <= current_position]
played_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in songs_played_so_far]

print('current_position', current_position)
print('played_song_ids', played_song_ids)
print('played_song_count', len(played_song_ids))

# Fetch all liked songs (paginated)
liked_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('liked_page_index', page_index, 'page_count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        liked_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    # If fewer than page_limit returned, we might be at last page; still safe to continue until empty.
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        # still fetch next page to follow "loop through all pages" pattern
        continue

already_liked = [sid for sid in played_song_ids if sid in liked_ids]
to_like = [sid for sid in played_song_ids if sid not in liked_ids]

print('already_liked_in_played', already_liked)
print('already_liked_count', len(already_liked))
print('to_like', to_like)
print('to_like_count', len(to_like))

print('<reflection>No write actions yet; prepared correct subset based on queue current position and liked catalog.'+ '</reflection>')
